name: discord-emojigen-mcp
description: Generate Discord emoji from prompts and existing server emoji, upload them for immediate use, and safely remove only emoji created by this server.
long_description:
Generate and upload static custom emoji to one configured Discord server. Existing server emoji can be selected by ID as visual references, and successful creation returns a Discord mention ready for immediate use. Removal is stateless and allowed only when Discord reports that the authenticated bot created the emoji.

The Discord bot should receive only CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS. Do not grant MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS or Administrator.

discord_bot_token.title: Discord Bot Token
discord_bot_token.description: Bot token with CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS in the target guild

discord_guild_id.title: Discord Guild ID
discord_guild_id.description: The only Discord guild the server may access

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API Key
openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key for image generation

tools.name: list_server_emojis
tools.description: List guild emoji for discovery and visual reference IDs

tools.name: create_emoji
tools.description: Generate and upload an emoji, optionally using existing guild emoji as references

tools.name: list_created_emojis
tools.description: List emoji Discord reports were created by the authenticated bot

tools.name: remove_emoji
tools.description: Remove an emoji only after Discord confirms the authenticated bot created it
